notes: New: Coworkers. 14 ready-made AI coworkers (Word writer, Excel analyst, PowerPoint builder, database designer, PDF publisher, email, minutes, voice narrator, video explainer, data cleaner, translator, HR, tutor, IT helpdesk) and your own custom ones, working offline with a local model. Export any answer or document to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, Access, CSV, SQLite, web page, audio (WAV/MP3) and narrated video (MP4). A new installer with a choice of drive and folder, and a matching uninstaller.
